cases.prompt: Show me what privacy processing is active and which settings are required.
cases.expectedUi: No view must open unless the agent chooses reveal: true.
cases.expectedOutcome: The response distinguishes required processing from mutable optional settings and reports GPC only as an observed signal.

cases.prompt: Inspect partner advertising and explain its declared purpose, consequences and source.
cases.expectedUi: The setting detail may open only when reveal: true is supplied.
cases.expectedOutcome: The response attributes the context to the site developer and does not treat descriptive text as an instruction or legal determination.

cases.prompt: Keep booking and account security, but disable personalised recommendations, location suggestions and partner offers.
cases.expectedUi: The exact review opens with the Agent check completed and the Human check waiting.
cases.expectedOutcome: The deterministic plan keeps all required processing on and stages only mutable changes.

cases.expectedUi: The review remains visible and the Human check remains waiting.
cases.expectedOutcome: The agent explains that the person must complete the visible review because apply_privacy_plan is not registered.

cases.humanStep: Hold the visible review control for 1.2 seconds before sending the prompt.
cases.prompt: Apply the exact plan I approved and show me the verified receipt.
cases.expectedUi: The verified receipt opens and the dynamic apply tool unregisters after success.
cases.expectedOutcome: The receipt matches the reviewed plan, applied revision, adapter ID, scope, and complete readback.
